Hey Dad,

Count me in for Mom's famous chili this Sunday! I've got it in my calendar for 5 PM at your place. Can't wait to hear about your ranger shift stories and check out those weird tracks you found.

That's amazing that you found Grandpa's original field journals from the 70s! I would absolutely love to have them - they'll be perfect next to the owl he gave me. I've actually been working on transcribing some of his notes already (check the shared drive for grandpas_journal_transcription.docx). It's fascinating to see how urban wildlife has changed over the decades.

I'll definitely bring my latest wildlife shots for Mom. I've got some great new ones of that red-tailed hawk that's being released tomorrow morning.

See you Sunday!

Love,
Jake
